privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How {brand} collects and uses your personal data.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your mobile number, email, payment method and Transaction ID, and your exam answers and results. We do not ask for your name.

use.title: Why we use it
use.body: To verify payments, create your account and send login details, run exams and show results, and improve the service.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: For as long as your account exists, plus 1 year for exam data. PINs are never stored in a readable form.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body: We never sell your data. Trusted providers send emails and store data for us. Leaderboards show only partly hidden mobile numbers.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any privacy question, contact us: {contact}
